KB_Title: SQS backlog due to throttled Lambda consumer
KB_Description: The SQS queue backlog grew beyond threshold because the downstream Lambda consumer was throttled during burst traffic. Resolution: raise concurrency limits

KB_Title: ECS microservice restarting due to faulty container image
KB_Description: The ECS microservice restarted repeatedly because a faulty container image was deployed without a valid healthcheck endpoint. Resolution: roll back to the previous stable image
column6: and add automated healthcheck testing in CI/CD.

KB_Description: Kinesis shard hot-spotting occurred due to uneven partition key distribution. Resolution: redistribute partition keys

KB_Title: Step Functions timeout caused by DynamoDB latency
KB_Description: Step Functions workflow timed out due to increased DynamoDB query latency. Resolution: add query pagination

KB_Title: DynamoDB throttling during peak inventory sync

KB_Title: IAM access denied errors during microservice deployment
KB_Description: Multiple IAM access denied errors occurred because an incorrect IAM policy was attached to the CodeBuild role. Resolution: update the IAM policy
